title: Backup sequence = insert pool
text: Inserts, B-roll, clips and static people not talking on camera go into the `backup` sequence (1920x1080). A split screen counts as an insert: zoom it so the clip fills the frame and no edge of the split screen shows (example: Scale 268, Position (0.844, 0.640) on a 1280x720 source).
